protocols.description: List of IP protocols with their numbers, names, aliases, and comments. Each entry corresponds to one line in /etc/protocols.

number.description: The IANA-assigned protocol number (0–255 for IPv4).

aliases.description: List of alternative names for the protocol (e.g., 'internet' for 'ip').

comment.description: Optional descriptive comment (e.g., 'Internet Control Message Protocol').
